issues.where: the central lake, especially its west and south banks
issues.what: the broad brown border swells into soft, smooth lobes while the dark interior has a large smeared swirl; the lake reads like pigment poured into a relief map
issues.fix: tie the shallows and sediment to basin depth and inflows, then give the open water irregular wind texture and a narrow shore transition

issues.where: the western sea and the coastal strip just right of center
issues.what: the clouds break into a broad field of bright, similarly sized flecks with repeated diagonal spacing, turning a large part of the image into a granular overlay
issues.fix: build cloud banks with varied footprint, altitude and optical thickness, with softer thin edges and shadows that match each group's height

issues.where: the tan valley floors in the upper-left and lower-left crops
issues.what: the mountain texture breaks into angular, flat patches on the valley floors, with smeared streaks on the adjacent slopes
issues.fix: replace the patchy base texture with finer terrain-aligned erosion and distinct talus, bedrock and sediment detail

issues.where: across the ranges surrounding the large jagged lake at right
issues.what: the same pale branching ribs cover almost every slope at similar contrast, so the wide view reads like a relief map rather than terrain seen through air
issues.fix: vary the material and erosion scale between slopes and valleys, and let atmospheric scattering soften relief contrast with distance

issues.where: the lower-left crop around the dark circular basins
issues.what: the basins sit inside stacked, clean contour-like rings with near-black interiors, like holes cut into a heightfield
issues.fix: break up the terraces with irregular rock, debris and drainage, and retain some reflected or ambient light in the basin interiors

issues.where: both native-size mountain crops, strongest along the pale crests at right
issues.what: repeated parallel gullies and rounded crests have a uniformly soft, molded surface even where slopes are well lit
issues.fix: mix erosion patterns and ridge profiles and add relief detail at the native sampling scale rather than sharpening the existing blur

issues.where: upper-right crop, red-brown upland beside the branching blue channels
issues.what: the land breaks into a visibly square, blocky grid across the plateau and around the channel margins
issues.fix: remove the grid from the terrain or mask inputs and render the texture and channel edges at a finer sampling scale

issues.where: right crop, blue streams running down neighboring valleys
issues.what: the streams look like thin cyan outlines inked onto the terrain, with bright rims on both banks and little material transition into the valley floors
issues.fix: seat the channels in the relief, vary width and reflectance, and blend wet sediment or gravel into the banks

issues.where: upper-right mountains, around the orange points
issues.what: several isolated orange lights look pinned on top of the terrain; the strongest has a halo but no clear emitting feature or corresponding light on nearby rock
issues.fix: anchor each point to a visible emitter and make its glow and local spill follow the terrain and haze

issues.where: right crop, the curved shore of the small lake entering at upper left
issues.what: the dark fill meets the terrain at a narrow, nearly uniform pale outline, with little variation in nearshore depth or bank material
issues.fix: vary the shoreline by local slope and substrate and show a shallow-water gradient where the bank allows it
